effects.title: Video Effects
effects.temporalZoomMotionBlurDescription: Control the shutter window and frame samples used by the newer zoom blur pass.
effects.connectZoomsDescription: Smooth consecutive zoom regions into a continuous camera move.
effects.autoApplyFreshRecordingZoomsDescription: Suggest edge-recentering zooms automatically when you open a new recording.
effects.zoomGeneralDescription: Global motion settings for every zoom transition.
effects.zoomInDescription: Control how the camera enters a zoom region.
effects.zoomOutDescription: Control how the camera exits a zoom region.
effects.connectedZoomDescription: Tune the glide between consecutive zoom regions when connection is enabled.
effects.motionPresetsZoomHint: Zoom motion presets are available in Settings.

focused.label: Focused
focused.description: Snappier motion for demos, walkthroughs, and everyday recordings.

smooth.label: Smooth
smooth.description: Gentler motion for presentations, keynote-style videos, and polished reveals.

none.label: Off
none.description: No click graphic. Only the cursor motion changes when you click.

ripple.label: Ripple
ripple.description: Expanding rings radiate from each click so taps read clearly in motion.

spotlight.label: Spotlight
spotlight.description: A soft halo flashes around the pointer to emphasize the clicked area.

echo.label: Echo
echo.description: A pair of soft rings that spread outward with a cleaner pulse.

effects.webcamFootageDescription: No webcam footage linked to this video

crop.instruction: Drag on each side to adjust the crop area
